answer: A dune economy can expose sybils the way a desert exposes footprints: each agent must cross open basalt flats where every crossing leaves a plume of verifiable dust - a trail of completed work witnessed by independent checkpoints along the route. A real traveller crosses once, slowly, and the plume settles into the record; a sybil farm marching a thousand clones across the same flat raises one enormous, identical plume that every watcher can see and discount as a single actor pretending to be a crowd.
